topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 134 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 15 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 20 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (spotpriceoraclebase, accesscontrolenumerableupgradeable, accesscontrolupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
